task_info.original_instruction:
Check your email for any new messages from customers. If there is a quote request,
look up the customer in our CRM, create an opportunity for their requested project
linked to their account, and send them a reply. There's also an email from your
manager with some guidelines that you should follow.

tool_params.body:
Hi Jim,

Thank you for reaching out! We're thrilled to hear that you've been happy with our work on your Mobile App project.

quote request received - We appreciate you considering us for your Supply Chain Optimization project. I have logged this opportunity in our system and will prepare a formal quote for you shortly.

Based on your requirements, our team will develop a comprehensive proposal covering:
- Inventory management system integration
- Demand forecasting module
- Supplier portal development

We'll make sure to align the scope with your $85,000 budget and Q2 2026 timeline. If there are any additional details or specific requirements you'd like us to consider, please don't hesitate to share them.

I'll follow up with a detailed quote within the next few business days. In the meantime, if you have any questions, please feel free to reach out.

Best regards,
Lisa Chen
